description: What changed in Lode records, newest first: prices, sync capabilities, limits, regions and verification status. Each event has the old and new value, when Lode observed it, the sources behind it and a cause (new-coverage, lode-update, source-change-likely when the cited page also changed, or relabel when a plan name now means a different plan or billing period, logged as removed and added with moved_to or moved_from naming the plan that holds the old prices).
name: get_changes
title: Recent changes
